notes.title: 03/10 (Sun) Update - Training Day skin added and features added
notes.notes:
○Add skin
- Claire Training Day skin added (+Barbell Staff)

○Cutscene added
- Two types of cutscenes are included in story mode to improve understanding of the story.

○Added features

○Saintess’s Trials added

○Model fixed
-Fixed an issue where the Ruins Guardian’s modeling was not displayed properly.
-Fixed an issue where the Navy Soldier's wrist looked distorted

○Bug fixes

-Fixed an issue where enemy A.I did not work properly when summoning a soldier and then canceling the summoning.
-Fixed an issue where exp did not increase when using FreeCam
-Fixed an issue where the battle sound effect volume was too loud
-Fixed an issue where the Get Status UI button was not clickable
-Fixed an issue where the text in the artifact mounting window was cut off
-Fixed an issue where Siren failed to transform

notes.title: 08/21 (Mon) Update - Bunny girl skin and rune option added
notes.notes:

○Features added

notes.title: June 6th (Sat) Update - Rune system and Saintess's trial update
notes.notes:
○Add Rune System - Unlocked when Challenge Mode is unlocked.
- You can acquire Common/Magic/Rare/Unique/Legendary runes with 500 points.
- Runes grant various options and can be equipped to Claire or soldiers to increase their stats.
- You can create a rune of the desired grade with the fragments obtained by dismantle the rune.

○Add Saintess's Trial - Unlocked when the 3rd Challenge Mode map is unlocked.
- You can increase the points you get by adding various trials.

We hope you can enjoy various combinations through this rune system.
Thanks for playing.

notes.title: 05/20 (Sat) Update - Challenge Mode "Siren's Tomb" map added and special soldier
notes.notes:
○Added Claire skin
-Added Claire skin "Bikini Swimsuit"

○Added Challenge Mode Map
-Added Challenge Mode Map "Siren's Tomb"

○Added Special Soldiers
-Naval Soldier = A rifle shooter with long range and high damage.
-Siren = A powerful mercenary that attacks the entire map by becoming gigantic.

○Added Artifact
-Continuous Reload = Attacks 2 times by consuming life force with a chance. (For single ranged attack soldiers)
-Reinforced Bullet = Increases ATK significantly. (For single ranged attack soldiers)
-Counterattack Knob = Counterattacks the enemy's attack with a probability. (For single melee attacking soldiers)
-Leather Epaulets = Receive less damage from enemies' area attacks.

○Added Skill
-Will of Protection = Claire's mana point is restored when the target being healed is attacked by an enemy.
-Shield of the void = Allies receiving area healing take less damage from enemies' ranged attacks.

○Added Upgrades
-Goddess' Blessing II = Adds starting holy power.
-Veteran Soldier Ⅱ = Raises the soldier's basic ability level.

○Added Features
-Provides information upon battle completion (The ally who attacked the most/The ally who blocked the most attacks)
-Improved Extra UI

notes.title: Bug fixes for Friday, May 12
notes.notes:

-Artifact, Shock Sinker - Fixed a probability bug

notes.title: The Last Saintess Update Plan (04/12/2023)
notes.notes:
Hello, this is eTIRUe.

We're sorry to hear that the current game "The Last Saintess" doesn't seem to be providing enough enjoyment for our users,
but we're encouraged by the number of people who see the game's potential and give us feedback.
We've been working hard on improvements since yesterday, but we're sorry to inform you that the update has been delayed.
We're working on the following and should be able to update in the next 6 hours at the earliest.



-Doubling the amount of points earned in the game
-Fixed the UI for summoning soldiers
-Extra soldiers available in story mode
-Balanced soldier stats
-Increased Claire's magic power and magic recovery rate
-Changed options for some artifacts
-Removed Starlight of Hellendil upgrade
-Changed leveling rewards (artifacts and Claire's skills)
-Fixed a bug that prevented the Endless Mode achievement from being awarded
-Added tutorial skip on second playthrough of Story Mode
-Added skip to Story Mode failure cutscene
-Extra menu UI improvements


We prepared hard, but
The understanding of the genre was lower than we thought.
So that users can evaluate it as a good game
We will continue to improve.

Thank you for playing.

notes.title: The Last Saintess Update Plan (04/10/2023)
notes.notes:
Hello, this is eTIRUe.
We've heard a lot of reviews saying the difficulty is difficult after release.
We didn't mean to make the difficulty difficult.
With so much testing done in finalizing the game,
it seems that all the developers have become so proficient that we didn't consider the difficulty too difficult.
(Especially, it seems to have been more so after repeating the story mode clear to fix the ending bug.)
It's our fault. sorry.
Currently, we are modifying the extra menu that is supposed to open when Story Mode is cleared so that it opens after playing Story Mode once.
We are changing to allow points to be acquired in Story Mode so that you can upgrade from the Extra Menu.



-Unlock the extra menu after trying Story Mode 1 time
-Points can be earned in Story Mode
-Added "Get More Points" upgrade to the extra menu

We will fix it and update it as soon as possible.
Thanks a lot for your comments.
We will try to make the game more fun.
